title: Add autosave drafts, My Drafts section, and unpublish dialog

requirements.summary: Implement autosave every 30 seconds in Create Post page with draft saved indicator
acceptanceCriteria: Autosave triggers every 30 seconds if any form field has been modified
Autosave calls saveDraft on first save and updateDraft on subsequent saves for the same session
A small non-intrusive 'Draft saved' message appears briefly after each successful autosave
Autosave does not trigger if all fields are empty
Autosave timer is cleared when the user submits or cancels the form

file_operations.description: Add autosave functionality with useEffect timer that calls saveDraft mutation every 30 seconds when form has non-empty content. Track the current draft ID in component state to use updateDraft for subsequent saves. Add a subtle 'Draft saved' indicator near the form that appears briefly after successful autosave. Clear the interval timer on form submit, cancel, or component unmount. Verify the authorization component's usage instructions before implementing to ensure proper authentication checks.

requirements.summary: Add 'Save as Draft' button to Create Post form that saves and navigates to My Drafts
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Save as Draft' button is visible in the Create Post form
Clicking it saves the current form data as a draft and redirects to My Drafts
The button shows a loading state while the save is in progress
A toast notification confirms successful draft save

file_operations.description: Add a 'Spara som utkast' button positioned next to the existing 'Skapa inlägg' submit button. Wire it to call the saveDraft mutation from useQueries, show loading state during save, display a toast notification on success, and navigate to '/drafts' using React Router. Include error handling with toast notifications for failed saves.

requirements.summary: Create My Drafts page with list of user drafts and Edit/Publish/Delete actions
acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated users can navigate to 'My Drafts' from the header navigation
The page lists all drafts belonging to the current user
Each draft shows title, last saved date, and a truncated content preview
Edit action loads the draft into the Edit Post page with all fields pre-populated
Publish action promotes the draft to published status and removes it from the drafts list
Delete action shows a confirmation dialog before permanently removing the draft
An empty state message is shown when there are no drafts
The drafts list is not visible to unauthenticated users

file_operations.description: Create a new page component that fetches the current user's drafts using useGetMyDrafts hook. Display drafts in a card grid showing title, formatted last saved timestamp (createdAt field), and truncated content preview using the contentTruncator utility. Each draft card includes three action buttons: 'Redigera' (navigate to /edit/:id), 'Publicera' (call updatePost mutation with status='published', show confirmation toast, invalidate drafts query), and 'Ta bort' (show confirmation dialog using shadcn/ui AlertDialog, call deletePost mutation). Include loading, error, and empty state handling. Wrap the page content with ProtectedRoute logic or redirect unauthenticated users. Verify the authorization component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a navigation link to 'Mina utkast' in the header navigation, positioned between 'Skapa inlägg' and the admin link. Show this link only when the user is authenticated (using useInternetIdentity hook). Link to '/drafts' route.
Register the new '/drafts' route in the TanStack Router configuration, wrapping it with ProtectedRoute to require authentication. Import and render the MyDraftsPage component.

requirements.summary: Add unpublish confirmation dialog when toggling off 'Publicera omedelbart' on published posts
acceptanceCriteria: Turning off the 'Publicera omedelbart' toggle on an existing published post immediately shows a dialog
The dialog presents three clearly labeled buttons: 'Delete permanently', 'Save as Draft', and 'Cancel'
'Delete permanently' deletes the post and redirects the user away from the edit page
'Save as Draft' converts the post status to draft and optionally redirects to My Drafts
'Cancel' dismisses the dialog and restores the toggle to its enabled (published) state
The toggle does not visually change to off until the user confirms 'Save as Draft' or 'Delete permanently'

file_operations.description: Create a reusable dialog component using shadcn/ui AlertDialog that presents three action buttons: 'Ta bort permanent', 'Spara som utkast', and 'Avbryt'. Accept props for postId, onDelete callback, onSaveDraft callback, and onCancel callback. Style buttons appropriately (destructive for delete, primary for save draft, secondary for cancel). Include clear Swedish text explaining the consequences of each action.

Add logic to detect when the 'Publicera omedelbart' toggle is turned off on an existing published post. Track the previous toggle state in component state or ref. When the toggle changes from true to false and the post is already published, prevent the toggle state change and show the UnpublishDialog. Wire the dialog callbacks: onDelete calls deletePost mutation and navigates to home, onSaveDraft calls updatePost with status='draft' and navigates to My Drafts, onCancel restores the toggle to true and closes the dialog. The toggle state should only change after user confirms an action.

Add the same unpublish dialog logic as CreatePostPage. When editing an existing published post and the user attempts to toggle 'Publicera omedelbart' off, show the UnpublishDialog with the same three action callbacks. Ensure the toggle state does not change until the user confirms an action. After 'Save as Draft' or 'Delete permanently', navigate appropriately (My Drafts or home page).

requirements.summary: Add React Query hooks for draft-related backend calls with proper cache invalidation
acceptanceCriteria: useSaveDraft mutation hook is available and calls the backend saveDraft method
useUpdateDraft mutation hook is available
useGetMyDrafts query hook fetches the current user's drafts
useDeleteDraft mutation hook is available
All draft mutations invalidate the getDraftsByUser query cache on success

file_operations.description: Add four new hooks: useSaveDraft (mutation calling actor.saveDraft with title, content, author, images parameters, returning draft ID), useUpdateDraft (mutation calling actor.updateDraft with id, title, content, author, images), useGetMyDrafts (query calling actor.getMyDrafts with queryKey ['myDrafts'], enabled when actor and user are authenticated), and useDeleteDraft (mutation calling actor.deletePost with draft ID). For all mutations, add onSuccess callbacks that invalidate the ['myDrafts'] query cache using queryClient.invalidateQueries. Follow the existing pattern in the file for error handling and actor dependency checks. Verify the authorization component's usage instructions before implementing to ensure proper authentication state handling.
